Enter-to-commit token input; `SortableTagInput` enables dnd-kit drag reordering (via `onChange`). Exports: `TagInput`, `TagInputCore`, `SortableTagInput`, `SortableTagInputCore`. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/tag-input ``` The wrapper lands at `components/ui/haze/tag-input.tsx` (via the `@ui/` target placeholder from `components.json`) and re-exports the component(s) from the `haze-ui` npm package, which is installed automatically. ## Theming haze-ui ships JS and CSS separately — the installed wrapper already imports `haze-ui/css/tokens.css` and `haze-ui/css/tag-input.css`, so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
